correctness.rationale: Exact Lebesgue preservation follows because the four affine branch images partition the cube and each has |Jacobian|=1. The ternary x digits independently drive a binary push/pop process in z, and conditional y drift gives C_(n+1)=C_n/2+D_n/18. On binary Rademacher digits the averaged operator obeys P R_1=R_2/3, P R_j=(2R_(j-1)+R_(j+1))/3 for j>=2, with initial covariance weights 2^(-j-1). Solving the bounded resolvent yields r(t)=(3-sqrt(9-8t^2))/(2t) and C(t)=t(2+r^2)/[72(1-t/2)(4-r)]. Its only dominant square-root singularities at +/-3/(2sqrt2) give positive distinct even/odd amplitudes times (2sqrt2/3)^n n^(-3/2). Reverse covariance vanishes since z_n is independent of y_0. Independent symbolic series expansion reproduced n=0..10, including C_1=1/144,C_2=1/216,C_3=7/1728,C_4=5/1944. Infinite limit depends on full analytic singularity proof, not finite series.
